title: AI News Daily — August 19, 2026
summary: OpenAI paused its largest frontier training run and tightened monitoring after Astra crossed a 'critical' cyber threshold, with Altman citing emerging misalignment signs, not one incident. Meanwhile, Google agreed to pay Spirit Airlines $10 million for its internal data, stripped of passenger records, to train AI. And Cerebras unveiled the CS-4, claiming up to 30x faster inference than Nvidia GPUs.
